name: Dylan's Daily Torah
subtitle: This week's portion, a section a day
internet: Needed the first time each day (for the texts)
description: This week's Torah portion in English and Hebrew: what happens in it, its four main lessons, its haftarah, where it falls among all 54 portions, and the Hebrew year as a wheel with the moon and the holidays coming up.

Then today: the day's section of the portion, an insight to take into the day, the verse of the day in Hebrew and English, Rashi on it, and a passage of the Talmud that discusses it, each with its full text a tap away.
features: A section a day: the whole portion in a week
Lessons and a daily insight in plain English, written for every portion
The verse of the day in Hebrew and English
Rashi and the Talmud on it, with the full text a tap away
The Hebrew date, the year as a wheel, and the next holidays
